verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into Sett's Grit bar and eat a charged Haymaker; you win if you poke with E and punish him the instant that bar is empty.

brief.thesis: Sett's W (Haymaker) stores every point of damage he takes as Grit and detonates it as a shield plus a true-damage-center punch, which means standard Yorick melee trades directly fund his best defensive and offensive tool. The 47.4% win rate over 78 games and Sett's lane and solo-kill advantage both trace back to this: Yorick's kit wants extended auto trades, and this matchup punishes exactly that.

theirWindow.when: Grit bar full, W off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He will cast W for a shield and a true-damage center hit, then follow with Q (Knuckle Down) bonus max-HP damage. Disengage before he reaches this threshold rather than fighting through it.

yourWindow.when: He just cast W, shield gone
yourWindow.what: Commit Q (Last Rites) and extend the trade immediately. His Haymaker is on an 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s cooldown and he has no shield or true damage until it's back.

powerCurve.note: Grit-fed sustain and auto trades favor Sett
R (Show Stopper) adds global kill pressure
Maiden (R) and Trinity Force close the gap

start.why: 53.2% win rate over 47 games; the regen-on-hit and damage reduction offset Sett's empowered right-punch poke without you needing to trade autos back.

boots.why: 48.5% win rate over 66 games at 73.3% pick rate; flat damage reduction on autos directly cuts the value of his alternating punches and Q (Knuckle Down) bonus hits.

core.why: Appears in the majority of recorded build paths for this matchup and gives the stat breadth to survive early trades while scaling into mid game.
Listed in the top core paths; the armor shred stacks on top of your E (Mourning Mist) armor reduction to make late trades hit harder.
Part of the 100%-winrate path recorded (small sample); ability haste lets you reset Q (Last Rites) and E (Mourning Mist) faster to re-poke after his Haymaker goes down.

situational.when: he is consistently landing E (Facebreaker) into R (Show Stopper) on you
his Q (Knuckle Down) move speed is letting him close distance before you can wall him
the lane turns into a split-push stalemate instead of a dueling lane

runes.keystoneWhy: Recorded at 47.6% win rate; Grasp's proc sustain lets you siege waves and heal passively instead of initiating extra auto trades that would otherwise feed his Grit bar.

summoners.why: Exhaust+Flash is recorded at 72.7% win rate; Exhaust directly weakens the damage output that feeds his Haymaker shield and neutralizes his E (Facebreaker) into R (Show Stopper) all-in.

playing.title: Trade with E, not autos
playing.detail: Use E (Mourning Mist, 700 range) to poke from outside his 490-range Facebreaker and his melee auto range. Standing in auto range just fills his Grit bar for free.

playing.title: Track his Grit meter
playing.detail: His W resource fills from every point of damage he takes. If it looks near full, back off instead of continuing the trade into a free shield and true-damage punch.

playing.title: Punish empty Haymaker
playing.detail: The instant he casts W with no Grit banked, commit Q (Last Rites) and go all-in. He has no burst defense until the 18-12s cooldown resets.

playing.title: Wall off his Facebreaker
playing.detail: Drop W (Dark Procession) between you when he closes with Q's move speed bonus, denying the dual-side positioning his E (Facebreaker, 490 range) stun needs.

playing.title: Respect fully-stocked cooldowns
playing.detail: Once both E (as low as 10s cooldown at max rank) and R (Show Stopper, 120-80s cooldown) are up, don't stand isolated where he can pull then ult you.

playing.title: Play for waves, not kills
playing.detail: The lane is structurally defensive and he out-solo-kills you, so prioritize denying CS with E poke over forcing extended trades.

playing.title: Save Maiden for forced fights
playing.detail: Hold R (Eulogy of the Isles, 160-100s cooldown) for moments he's forced to engage near your wall or tower, where the Maiden's bonus damage and automatic Walker spawns can swing it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, rune pages, and all win rates above come from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the tactical reasoning about Grit-feeding trades, poke windows, and wall usage is my own read of the kit.

stats.opponentTip: Use [E] to poke without allowing him to gain too much Grit with (W). Try to kill him if he is running low on health after he loses his Grit on his (W).
